request.query: mutation KartkaDetails($id: Int!) { fetchMangaAndChapters(input: {id: $id, fetchManga: true, fetchChapters: false}) { manga { id url title thumbnailUrl author artist description genre status } } }

manga.title: No Taste for Gyaru and Vegetables
manga.author: Tsutsumi Kotatsu
manga.description: Genichi Tomita, a newspaper reporter, has just been transferred to a rural town. While house-hunting, he arranges to rent a vacant house through a referral from a former colleague back in Tokyo. But when he arrives at the address he was given, he finds nothing but a dilapidated, rundown house. As Genichi stands there at a loss, a gyaru dressed in farm work clothes suddenly appears before him — Shuri Nakazato.
